# Scott Harris Law

> San Diego-based law firm specializing in medical malpractice, legal malpractice, and personal injury claims with expertise in birth injuries, surgical errors, medication mistakes, and nursing home negligence.

Scott Harris Law is a personal injury and medical malpractice firm serving San Diego and Southern California. Led by attorney Scott S. Harris, the firm handles complex cases involving healthcare provider negligence, including birth injuries, cancer misdiagnosis, medication errors, and elder abuse claims. The firm offers free consultations and handles Kaiser Permanente arbitrations.

## Core Practice Areas

- [Medical Malpractice](https://www.scottsharrislaw.com/practice-areas/medical-malpractice): Medical malpractice: surgical errors, misdiagnosis, nursing home abuse
- [Personal Injury](https://www.scottsharrislaw.com/practice-areas/personal-injury): Personal injury law: negligence claims, brain injuries, spine injuries, wrongful death
- [Legal Malpractice](https://www.scottsharrislaw.com/practice-areas/legal-malpractice): Legal malpractice claims: attorney negligence & professional conduct violations
- [Practice Areas Overview](https://www.scottsharrislaw.com/practice-areas): Scott Harris Law practice areas: medical malpractice, legal malpractice, personal injury

## Birth & Pediatric Injuries

- [Birth Injuries](https://www.scottsharrislaw.com/practice-areas/medical-malpractice/birth-injuries): Birth injury attorney: cerebral palsy, Erb's palsy, prenatal negligence
- [Cerebral Palsy](https://www.scottsharrislaw.com/practice-areas/medical-malpractice/cerebral-palsy): Cerebral palsy birth injury: physician negligence & brain damage claims
- [Children Medical Malpractice](https://www.scottsharrislaw.com/practice-areas/medical-malpractice/children-medical-malpractice): Children's medical malpractice: pediatric surgical errors & misdiagnosis

## Medication & Drug-Related Injuries

- [Medication Errors](https://www.scottsharrislaw.com/practice-areas/medical-malpractice/medication-errors): Medication errors: prescription mistakes, overdose, communication failures
- [Drug Administration Errors](https://www.scottsharrislaw.com/practice-areas/medical-malpractice/drug-administration-errors): Drug administration errors: medication mistakes & overdose injury claims
- [Anesthesia Injuries](https://www.scottsharrislaw.com/practice-areas/medical-malpractice/anesthesia-injuries): Anesthesia injury claims: improper drug administration & post-surgery complications

## Diagnostic & Surgical Errors

- [Cancer Misdiagnosis](https://www.scottsharrislaw.com/practice-areas/medical-malpractice/cancer-misdiagnosis): Cancer misdiagnosis claims: failure to diagnose & delayed cancer treatment
- [Radiology Errors](https://www.scottsharrislaw.com/practice-areas/medical-malpractice/radiology-errors): Radiology errors: misread imaging, delayed diagnosis, cancer detection failures
- [Medical Mistakes](https://www.scottsharrislaw.com/practice-areas/medical-malpractice/medical-mistakes): Medical mistakes: surgical & medication errors, post-surgical care negligence

## Elder Care & Healthcare Facility Negligence
